# HeyRanks

> HeyRanks checks a small business's website for the technical basics that Google and AI assistants rely on, explains each problem in plain English, and gives copy-paste code to fix it. Paid plans rescan every Monday and email a report with up to 5 prioritised fixes. It costs $10 one-time for 180 days (26 weekly reports), with no auto-renewal.

HeyRanks is a product of DexoSoft Solutions, based in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India. It suits local businesses (clinics, restaurants, salons, real estate, coaching), e-commerce brands, freelancers and marketing agencies.

## What the free homepage scan checks (40 checks)
- Search basics: HTTPS, title, meta description, headings, canonical, indexability, robots.txt, XML sitemap
- AI-crawler readiness: whether robots.txt lets GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended and PerplexityBot read the site, llms.txt, and Schema.org business markup
- Security and domain: HTTPS redirect, SSL certificate, security headers, mixed content, DNSSEC, domain registration expiry
- Email authentication: SPF, DMARC, DKIM and MX on the real email domain
- Speed (Google Lighthouse) and simple conversion signals (calls to action, contact details, trust signals, analytics)

## The $10 full audit
- Crawls up to 50 pages: broken links, redirect chains, duplicate titles and content, canonicals, thin pages, orphan pages
- Mobile and desktop Lighthouse scores and real-user Core Web Vitals when available
- Comparison with competitor websites the customer chooses
- Every issue with evidence, steps, code, time estimate and a way to verify the fix; a 30-day plan
- Keyword, backlink and AI-assistant answer data where those data sources are enabled; reports list their sources

## Scoring
- Separate category scores; checks that couldn't be measured are left out rather than counted as failures; any critical issue caps the overall score

## Key facts
- Free scan available on the homepage
- No auto-renewal; 30-day money-back guarantee
- No technical skills needed
